   - **Static factory methods**: `Contributor.from(User)`, `Stats.from(Counter)` — canonical factory pattern on the target type
   - **Method reference normalization**: `.filter(t -> t instanceof X)` → `.filter(X.class::isInstance)`

   - **Spring `@Accessors(chain = true)`**: SystemInfo uses fluent setters, enabling `.map()` replacement of `doOnNext`
   - **Reconciler pattern**: Reconcilers run on dedicated scheduler (not event loop) but `.block()` calls are still fragile and inconsistent

     ```java
     public static Contributor from(User user) {
         var contributor = new Contributor();
         contributor.setName(user.getMetadata().getName());
         contributor.setDisplayName(user.getSpec().getDisplayName());
         contributor.setAvatar(user.getSpec().getAvatar());
         return contributor;
     }
     ```

     ```java
     public static Stats from(Counter counter) {
         return Stats.builder()
                 .visit(counter.getVisit())
                 .upvote(counter.getUpvote())
                 .totalComment(counter.getTotalComment())
                 .approvedComment(counter.getApprovedComment())
                 .build();
     }
     ```
